sources.author: Dutch App
patch_list: Includes ad removal. Disables optional Analytics, Crashlytics identifiers and reports, queued Google SDK diagnostics and Firebase Sessions. Retains functional push, authentication and report submission.

Enables local En Route access and nearby static-camera warnings using the app's real data and distance settings. Requests notification permission and preserves later notification choices, location permissions, authentication and purchases.
Preserves the original public app certificate in Google SDK requests and uses the authorized community Maps key. Keeps the original Firebase and Places configuration.
Removes banner and native advertising and their list placements. Stops the app's Google Mobile Ads initialization and requests. Preserves reports, maps, location and purchases.
Skips the Premium introduction, removes settings Upgrades and removes the Premium/Remove ads toolbar overflow from every main page. Preserves normal onboarding completion and purchase status.
Removes mandatory advertising consent from Home setup and allows completion without granting advertising consent. Includes ad and tracking controls; retains optional location and notification setup.
